title: Person
description: One face cluster. Written only by the agent (catalog/people.py assigns faces to a person; nothing here ever picks a name — that's a person doing it once, through whatever UI reads/updates this). No face embeddings or bounding boxes ever appear here or anywhere in Firestore; those stay local to the agent's SQLite catalog. This document's id is what item.person_ids references.

id.description: The local catalog's `people.id`, as a string. Referenced by item.person_ids.

name.description: Null until someone labels this cluster. An unnamed person is still a real, usable cluster — 'the person in these 40 photos', just without a name attached yet.

face_count.description: How many detected faces belong to this person, across the whole library.

cover_thumbnail_key.description: Blob key of one representative photo's thumbnail (their first detected face), for a 'People' picker UI to show without an extra query.

created_at.description: When this person (cluster) was first created — i.e. when their first face didn't match anyone existing.
